subject: log-fields
text: - A closed span's line — a second record class since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans, a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-09) as built — is written for each closed span whose target the allowlist admits, and no line when a span is created, recorded to, entered or exited: `{time} {LEVEL} {target} service.name=… service.version=… span={the span's name}`, then the span's own fields in the order recorded, then the layer's close fields `message`, `time.busy` and `time.idle`; level and target are the span's, the two timings are `tracing-subscriber`'s own (no escher code reads a clock for them), and `span` is a reserved field name; every pair, `span` included, passes the §8 scrub under the span's target; a string value is Debug-quoted (`span="command"`, `message="close"`), a number or a bool bare; a span from a target outside the allowlist writes no byte at any point; an event's line is unchanged, an event emitted inside a span included — it gains no span name and no span field; as read from a real capture: `… INFO escher_driver service.name=blitz-tests service.version=0.3.0-beta.2 span="command" verb="click" passes=1 settled=true added=1 removed=0 changed=1 message="close" time.busy=11.0ms time.idle=4.51µs` (packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:102-116; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:138-177; packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs:200-250; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md)

subject: log-fields
text: - The verdict fields: `task, client_exit, isolated, session_tools, client_version, model, tool_calls, server_tool_calls, wrong_calls, wrong_call_bar_pct, refused_calls, error_calls, spacer_calls, transcript_errors, counts_agree, lint_calls, screenshot_calls, advance_calls, part_reads, recorded_sessions, recording_kept, tasks_met, check_steps, check_expects, check_passed, check_can_fail, num_turns, duration_ms, cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, transcript_file, outcome, reasons, ts` (`final_count` retired at 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test) — every one a count, a boolean or a closed word, no transcript text, tool argument, tool answer, reply or check; `counts_agree` ties the server's span lines to the transcript (the `tool_call` lines equal the escher tool uses, its refused + error lines the escher results marked `is_error`), `wrong_calls` = refused + error + foreign tool uses + permission denials, deciding the verdict against `wrong_call_bar_pct` (5), and the reasons add `capability-unused` (a counted verb or a part read unused), `recording-not-kept` and `wrong-calls-over-bar` (`wrong_calls × 100 > 5 × tool_calls`) after `task-unmet`, then `no-check`, `check-failed`, `check-cannot-fail` (scripts/cold-agent.sh:398-498; scripts/cold-agent.sh:161-175)

subject: log-fields
text: - `span_counts` also returns the accepted `tool_call` span lines of each counted verb (`lint`, `screenshot` and `advance`) from `target/cold-agent/server.log`, which the pipe reads by span name only and never prints or copies (scripts/cold-agent.sh:161-175).

subject: log-fields
text: - The live server child runs `mcp --record` into `target/cold-agent/record/`, made with `mkdir -m 700`, and keeps one check per accepted `start`; `recording` reads that directory for `recorded_sessions` and `recording_kept` only, the pipe never prints or copies the kept checks, `cleanup` removes them with the state, and the replay children run without `--record` (scripts/cold-agent.sh:257-271).

subject: log-fields
text: - `tasks_met` reads accepted snapshot answers only, resets an app on its accepted `start` and joins the latest answer of each part of a paged screen, and the replay's expect match decodes a paged answer's JSON-escaped text the same way (`paged`, `screen_text`); the decoded text goes into the match only, never into an event or the verdict (scripts/cold-agent.sh:178-228).

subject: emitter-examples
text:
- **examples**
  - wasm_hello logs "Starting app..." at info (examples/wasm_hello/src/lib.rs:107)
  - Example output uses `println!`/`eprintln!` (examples/screenshot.rs:203; examples/paint_bench.rs:34; examples/paint_bench.rs:321; examples/multi_doc.rs:111-115), except `seven_guis_native` and `escher-session`, which log through escher-telemetry (below); `escher-session`'s own lines, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, are the binary's one `eprintln!` — `telemetry not installed: …` — and the endings the driver's command line writes for it: usage — one fixed line on stderr built from `VERBS` and the six task names (`counter` · `flight-booker` · `timer` · `crud` · `cells` · `load`), stdout empty, status 2; session error — the error object on stdout, carrying its fixed `remedy` beside `kind` and `message` since 2026-10-12-self-description, and its fixed message on stderr, status 3 (the host's was 1); accepted (status 0) and refused (status 1) — one line of JSON on stdout, stderr empty with `RUST_LOG` unset; and the host role's quiet end, status 0; since 2026-10-12-self-description `help` (at most one `--session <dir>`, not read) — `describe()`'s one line of JSON on stdout, status 0, reaching no session, `help` with an argument refused `malformed`, status 1, `help --session` with no directory or given twice usage, status 2, the usage line listing `help` after `stop` — every text a fixed string of the tables (packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:178-183; packages/escher-driver/src/error.rs:79-177); since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the `mcp` role — `escher-session mcp` writes JSON-RPC protocol lines only on stdout, nothing at its end, status 0 on `Ok` and status 3 with the error's fixed message on stderr on `Err`, `mcp` followed by anything but one `--record <dir>` usage (status 2, stdout empty), as is a `--record` anywhere else, twice or with no value once the call passed `validate`, the usage line gaining `; mcp role: mcp [--record <dir>]` after the host role, with `start <app> [--record <dir>]` and `host role: serve <app> --session <dir> [--record <dir>]`;
 a recording directory open to its group or others ends `start` with status 3 and nothing spawned and `mcp --record` with status 3, its fixed message on stderr and stdout empty, the two recording session errors ending status 3 like the rest; the two-argument form `<task> <state-dir>` is gone (it reads as an unknown verb, refused, status 1), every diagnostic is a fixed string holding no path, label, id or value, and no ending holds anything the caller typed (examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:31; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:278-293; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:341-368; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:370-383)

subject: emitter-escher-driver
emitter-escher-driver
text: - The published statement `docs/capabilities.md` restates this emitter's reach: the `command` and `tool_call` spans with closed-word, bool and count fields, stderr only, no driver line at the default `warn`, and the scrub's limits (the raw panic message, `log.file` on a bridged `js_console` record, the dropped third-party WARN or ERROR, the unscrubbed upstream apps and WPT runner); its pin `.github/scripts/test_capability_statement.py` reads none of these claims, so a change to the span set or to the scrub's limits is made in that document by hand (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-capability-statement/report.md)
